response.justification: The candidate is an experienced, versatile senior engineer, but the profile does not match the mandatory requirements. Professional C++ experience appears limited to roughly six months at National Instruments in 2014-2015 (plus an academic project), far short of the 5-10 years of hands-on C++ required, and there is no evidence of Windows-platform systems development, SQL Server/Oracle expertise, or fixed-income/capital-markets domain work. The RIDE Capital role is retail/investment fintech built in Node/TypeScript rather than investment banking or trading systems, and no Summit or derivatives exposure is shown. The overall stack (TypeScript, Node.js, DLang, MongoDB) is orthogonal to this engagement.
strengths: Long, senior-level career with broad full-stack and low-latency systems experience
Strong engineering practices: TDD, CI/CD, DevOps, open-source tooling authorship
Excellent communication signals — public talks, workshops, and courses delivered
concerns: Only ~6 months of professional C++ experience versus 5-10 years required
No fixed income, derivatives, or investment-banking domain background
No demonstrated Windows platform or SQL Server/Oracle depth

key_factors.factor: Windows platform and SQL Server/Oracle experience
